paras: Alopoglossus gorgonae is a species of lizard in the family Alopoglossidae. The species is native to northwestern South America.
The specific name, gorgonae, refers to the type locality, Gorgona Island, Colombia.
A. gorgonae is  found in southwestern Colombia and adjacent northwestern Ecuador.
The preferred natural habitat of A. gorgonae is forest, at altitudes from sea level to 500 m (1,600 ft).
